title: The Witness of Bellwether Lane
author: Bram Nystrom
blurb: Lior Thornbury, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
